reads.scope: Most recent earlier mutation of the identical canonical leaf path in committed trace order. Same-event writes and later events are excluded. A match records value continuity, not psychological necessity or complete causal provenance. No prior mutation does not establish initial-state origin. Derived-source metadata, payload dependencies and omitted history are not resolved by this projection. Absence is distinct from a zero value.
